# AWSAuth v1.4.1 - Table of Contents

> AWS Signature Version 4 Signing Library - Community-maintained fork

## Pages

- [ex_aws_auth](https://ex-aws-auth.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

- Changelog
  - [CHANGELOG](https://ex-aws-auth.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- Core
  - [AWSAuth](https://ex-aws-auth.hexdocs.pm/AWSAuth.md): Signs urls or authentication headers for use with AWS requests.
  - [AWSAuth.Credentials](https://ex-aws-auth.hexdocs.pm/AWSAuth.Credentials.md): AWS credentials struct for authentication.

- Streaming
  - [AWSAuth.EventStream](https://ex-aws-auth.hexdocs.pm/AWSAuth.EventStream.md): AWS Signature Version 4 signing for event stream messages.

- Plugins
  - [AWSAuth.Req](https://ex-aws-auth.hexdocs.pm/AWSAuth.Req.md): Req plugin for AWS Signature V4 authentication.
